articles.summary: Jesse Watters Primetime MAGA podcaster Tim Pool warned President Donald Trump that a crucial voter bloc wants to destroy his party. Pool made the bleak assessment on Thursday’s edition of Jesse Watters Primetime with Fox News host Jesse Watters, after the 80-year-old president’s election disaster this week. Republicans suffered a wipeout in Tuesday’s elections , with Democrats seizing both chambers of Congress in a sweeping repudiation of Trump and his party. The Republican collapse included GOP strongholds Texas, Kansas and South Carolina. Read more at The Daily Beast.
